subject: Weekly forecast handoff: Zephyr pilot + Q3 burst planning
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Mills <anna@zephyrhealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly forecast handoff: Zephyr pilot + Q3 burst planning

Team — kicking off this week's handoff for capacity sizing tied to the Zephyr pilot and two NRR expansion prospects. Quick context: Zephyr is targeting a limited pilot starting 2028-08-10 with a potential committed Reserved capacity ask post-pilot. They are sensitive to latency and want H100-class performance for inference-heavy evaluation.

Attached: q3_pipeline_forecast_v5.xlsx (sheet tab "ZE-PIPELINE"). The sheet has per-deal expected token throughput and weekly ramp assumptions for July - Sept. Action items I need this week:
- Finance (Laura): confirm whether Zephyr can commit to a 6-month reserved baseline or if we need to price for burst-only in month 1.
- Infra (Karthik): advise which GPU family we should reserve (A100-80 vs H100) given the workload profile and suggest a conservative reserved slot count + burst headroom.
- Sales (Ben / Aditya): confirm final estimated peak concurrent models and expected go/no-go date from Zephyr (they said early Aug, but need confirmation). Also include any other deals in the same window (Aperture prospect).

Meeting proposal: 2028-07-03 at 10:30 PT for a 30-min handoff (objective: lock numbers and publish runbook tasks). I've pasted a short excerpt of the Zephyr ramp from the sheet below.

ZE-PIPELINE (excerpt):
- Pilot week 1: 10k tokens/min sustained, ramp to 40k by week 4
- Pilot peak (evaluation runs): 120k tokens/min bursts (1-2 hrs/day)
- Expected post-pilot commit ask: 12 reserved GPU-hours/day (subject to pricing)

Thanks — Chloe
--
Chloe Martin
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast handoff: Zephyr pilot + Q3 burst planning

Thanks Chloe — quick finance note: we need three pieces to evaluate a reserved pricing proposal: confirmed start date for the commitment, contract term (3/6/12 months), and an estimate of the committed UPT (utilization per token estimate) so we can model blended unit economics. At present, if Zephyr is only willing to pilot with burst, we should price burst blocks vs reserved hourly bundles — they're very different margin profiles.

If Ben can confirm the likely commitment term and the earliest signature date, I can run a quick compare (reserved vs burst) and share a one-pager by 2028-07-02 EOD.

Laura
--
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-02T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast handoff: Zephyr pilot + Q3 burst planning

Chloe / team — reviewed the ZE-PIPELINE tab. Short takeaways:
- For latency-sensitive inference and mixed batch sizes, H100-80GB offers ~25-35% lower tail latency on our current runtime vs A100-80GB for the tested Zephyr model family. That suggests H100 reservations will materially improve SLO adherence for the pilot.
- Recommendation (conservative): Reserve 6 H100 slots for baseline (covers 12 reserved GPU-hours/day assuming 2-hour peak sustained), and configure a 3x burst headroom policy (i.e., allow dynamic burst access up to 18 additional GPUs backed by autoscaling and cost limits).
- If finance pushes back on H100 cost, fallback is 8 A100 reservations + higher burst target. Performance delta will require additional prefix caching tuning.

I attached the Fleet Burst Playbook link and a short runbook excerpt (see related_links). I'll also attach a short markdown playbook (fleet_burst_playbook.md) with the autoscaler configs and throttling thresholds. Please confirm whether we should prewarm KV caches for the pilot window (recommended).

Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Infrastructure, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Mills <anna@zephyrhealth.com>, Aperture Sales Ops <salesops@aperture.ai>
Date: 2028-07-02T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast handoff: Zephyr pilot + Q3 burst planning

Quick pipeline update — I spoke with Anna (Zephyr) this morning and they confirmed go/no-go for pilot by 2028-07-10; target pilot start is 2028-08-10. They indicated willingness to sign a 6-month commitment if pilot KPIs meet latency and cost thresholds.

Zephyr specifics (from convo):
- Expected evaluation peak concurrency: 4 concurrent heavy sessions (each ~30k tokens/min during evaluation).
- Post-pilot conservative commit ask: equivalent of 10 reserved GPUs (Chloe's sheet rounds to 12 GPU-hours/day — consistent).

Aperture (new): salesops@aperture.ai says they have an internal Q3 PoC that could run in parallel week-of 2028-09-05 with similar burst patterns; likely final decision by 2028-08-24. Potential to consolidate burst headroom, but needs networking isolation (VPC).

I'll lock dates with Anna and upload signed LOI when it arrives. Putting proposed meeting on 2028-07-03 10:30 PT — please accept if you can.

Ben
--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-07-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly forecast handoff: Zephyr pilot + Q3 burst planning — summary & next steps

Thanks everyone — short summary and owners: 
- Infra (Karthik): prepare H100 reservation plan: 6 reserved H100 slots + autoscaling burst to 18 GPUs, include prewarm KV step in runbook (owner: Karthik). Deliverable: config fragment and cost estimate by 2028-07-05 EOD.
- Finance (Laura): produce reserved vs burst pricing one-pager for 6-month term vs burst-only (owner: Laura). Deliverable: 2028-07-02 EOD (Laura noted she'll try for EOD yesterday — please confirm).
- Sales (Ben): confirm Zephyr LOI date and upload to HubSpot; confirm Aperture timeline (owner: Ben). Deliverable: LOI upload and date confirmation by 2028-07-10.

Meeting confirmed: 2028-07-03 10:30 PT (calendar invite sent). I've attached the Zephyr MOP draft that we'll share with the customer during the pilot kickoff (zephyr_mop_and_sla_draft.pdf).

If there's any change to the numbers above, reply-all with an updated headcount/reservation ask before the meeting.

Chloe
